import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int MOD;

    static class Mint {
        int value;

        Mint() { value = 0; }
        Mint(long x) { value = normalize(x); }

        static int normalize(long x) {
            int v = (int)(x % MOD);
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return v;
        }

        Mint add(Mint other) {
            int res = value + other.value;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new Mint(res);
        }

        Mint subtract(Mint other) {
            int res = value - other.value;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new Mint(res);
        }

        Mint multiply(Mint other) {
            long res = (long)value * other.value;
            return new Mint(res % MOD);
        }

        Mint divide(Mint other) {
            return multiply(other.inverse());
        }

        Mint inverse() {
            int a = value, m = MOD;
            int u = 0, v = 1;
            while (a != 0) {
                int t = m / a;
                m -= t * a;
                int temp = a; a = m; m = temp;
                u -= t * v;
                temp = u; u = v; v = temp;
            }
            // m should be 1
            return new Mint(u);
        }

        Mint negate() {
            return new Mint(-value);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(value);
        }
    }

    static Mint power(Mint a, long b) {
        Mint res = new Mint(1);
        Mint x = a;
        long p = b;
        while (p > 0) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(x);
            x = x.multiply(x);
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();

        int MAX = Math.max(n, m) + 1;
        Mint[] fact = new Mint[MAX];
        Mint[] invFact = new Mint[MAX];
        fact[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i-1].multiply(new Mint(i));
        }
        invFact[MAX-1] = fact[MAX-1].inverse();
        for (int i = MAX-2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i+1].multiply(new Mint(i+1));
        }

        // Combination function
        java.util.function.BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Mint> C = (x, y) -> {
            if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Mint(0);
            return fact[x].multiply(invFact[y]).multiply(invFact[x - y]);
        };

        Mint[] ptrWays = new Mint[m + 1];
        Mint[] ptrDp = new Mint[m + 1];
        ptrWays[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            ptrWays[i] = new Mint(0);
            ptrDp[i] = new Mint(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint comb = C.apply(l + r, l);
                Mint term = ptrWays[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).multiply(comb).multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2));
                ptrWays[i] = ptrWays[i].add(term);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint comb = C.apply(l + r, l);
                Mint add = new Mint((long)l * (l + 1) + (long)r * (r + 1)).divide(new Mint(2));
                Mint term1 = ptrWays[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).multiply(comb).multiply(add);
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(term1);
                Mint term2 = ptrDp[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).add(ptrDp[r].multiply(ptrWays[l]));
                term2 = term2.multiply(comb).multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(term2);
            }
        }

        Mint[][] dp = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        Mint[][] ways = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= m; s++) {
                dp[i][s] = new Mint(0);
                ways[i][s] = new Mint(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptrDp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptrWays[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Mint ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Mint way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    Mint comb = C.apply(s, add);
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptrWays[add]).multiply(comb));
                    Mint term = way.multiply(ptrDp[add]).add(ptrWays[add].multiply(ft));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(term.multiply(comb));
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[n][m]);
    }
}
